entities.name: Emancipation and the Black-Controlled Legislature
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: After emancipation in 1834, Dominica became unique in the British Caribbean: by 1838 its assembly was controlled by elected members of African descent — the only colony where this occurred. This was a remarkable achievement in the post-slavery Caribbean.
